scripts.patch-plist: /usr/libexec/PlistBuddy -c "Add :NSAudioCaptureUsageDescription string 'vidubber needs system audio'" node_modules/electron/dist/Electron.app/Contents/Info.plist 2>/dev/null; /usr/libexec/PlistBuddy -c "Add :NSScreenCaptureUsageDescription string 'vidubber needs screen capture'" node_modules/electron/dist/Electron.app/Contents/Info.plist 2>/dev/null; true
scripts.sign: npm run patch-plist && codesign --sign - --force --deep --entitlements entitlements.plist node_modules/electron/dist/Electron.app
